data.body:
[P2] Preserve requests when the event timestamps tie

GitHub timestamps have second precision, so a maintainer can apply `changes-requested` after the triggering push or ready-for-review event while both timestamps are equal. This comparison treats that newer request as preceding the trigger, allowing a delayed run or rerun to remove it. Preserve the label when timestamps are equal unless stronger ordering information proves it predates the trigger. Change the comparison to `>=` and update the equality regression test to expect preservation.
